conversation.text: Four iron arrows pierce player8's body almost simultaneously: one penetrates below the collarbone, one plunges into the abdomen, and two others sink deep into the thighs. The impact staggers him back two steps, slamming him heavily against the ruined altar. player8's fingers twitch, grasping the arrow shaft embedded in his abdomen, dark red blood frothing in his throat. His knees slowly bend, his armor scraping against the ground with a grating screech, before he finally collapses to his knees. His head droops, as if merely taking a weary nap. Blood snakes down the grooves of his armor, pooling into a small crimson puddle in the cracks of the stone bricks.
